method: Independent read-only comparison of current TypeScript, pinned source hierarchy, integration/access tests and migration mappings. This receipt is a code review, not a test execution or game result.

checks.name: source_dispatch_order
checks.finding: ReceptionService is proposed and guarded before RootedLine, PanelService, Chamber and Exposed. Inactive/unmeasured reception delegates; own blocking refusals remain visible.

checks.name: source_acquisition_order
checks.finding: Inherited support acquires before Exposed, Chamber, Panel, RootedLine and ReceptionService. SharedSeries invokes each own reducer once, then packet acquisition.

checks.name: distinct_event_owners
checks.finding: observed_exposed_reception and observed_reception_service are routed to distinct owners during live acquisition and replay. Native extension is explicit; exact inherited source alias/digest parity is not claimed.

checks.name: legacy_digest_compatibility
checks.finding: Reception enters sharedDigest and replay digest only after an own event. Actual published0.45 fixture coverage includes combined old layers; the new empty layer leaves old digests exact.

checks.name: atomic_restoration
checks.finding: Replay constructs fresh owners and checks the complete digest before replacing live owners. The accepted-state shortcut validates owner identity, revision and structural witness, including the native epoch option.

checks.name: current_epoch_acquisition
checks.finding: Common owner enables currentEpochAcquisition. The first actual return with a current bound tentative epoch commits the reset; later returns use acquired memory. Evidence and residual histories are retained.

checks.name: stationary_authority
checks.finding: Current-epoch native reset deletes stationary proof. Controls reset on epoch change, and a current actual zero delta is required before a longer wait batch.

checks.name: cumulative_wait
checks.finding: Source integer counters stay independently in0..128. Native caller clamps larger overall budgets to128, blocks exhaustion before fallback and keeps wait_spent through prefixes/restoration.

checks.name: physical_action_allowance
checks.finding: Common observed entry returns null at remaining<1 and supplies remaining_level_actions with max prefix min16. Access paths must fit remaining; confirmed waits use min(limit,16,remaining,wait_batch); runtime independently rejects oversized proposals.

checks.name: current_context_guards
checks.finding: Before guards bind layout, epoch, score, plan identity and command equality, availability, first observation/frame, then carrier positions. Outcomes preserve unknown/ambiguous/boundary as sealed prefixes and acquired contradictions as refusals.

checks.name: residual_consumed_scope
checks.finding: Only source record/apply/state closure is ported. Unassigned correspondence sets, repeated-role shapes, transitions, ambiguous arrivals and failures remain; independent residual navigation/forecast selection is not claimed.

checks.name: coverage_reconciliation
checks.finding: Four new source mappings are unique:projection and wait contract component_verified; access and consumed residual partial_transfer. Registry/workflow denominator remains unchanged; common snapshot is5/6branches.

remainingQualifications: Default own-layer source mode retains source defects for differential comparison; production common mode explicitly applies ownership, current-epoch and bounded-wait extensions.
Retained target/counterpart handling remains the source projection rule. A proposed reception is still a conditional hypothesis, not a terminal law or hidden-motion explanation.
Direct source-compatible access is not itself the zero-action-budget entry; the common owner and runtime enforce the physical allowance.
Full source inherited digest, complete caller parity and functional success remain separate evidence.
